**Your eligibility is currently INDETERMINATE for all three children: Alex, Blake, and Charlie.**

The main factor preventing a definitive eligibility determination is that **you have recently moved to the UK and your right-to-reside status has not yet been assessed**. - **Alex** (18): Qualifies as they are under 20 and in approved education

If your right-to-reside is established, you should be eligible to receive Child Benefit for all three children.
